description: Source code for the Lead doctype in ERPNext CRM module, defining the Lead class with methods for validation, linking, and conversion to other documents.

classes.name: Lead
classes.description: Class representing a sales lead, inheriting from SellingController, with methods for validation, linking, and conversion.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns a formatted string for the lead's feed display.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads customer info and contact details when lead is loaded.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the lead data.

methods.name: set_full_name
methods.description: Sets the full lead name based on first, middle, last names.

methods.name: validate_email_id
methods.description: Validates the email address for correctness and uniqueness.

methods.name: validate_contact_date
methods.description: Checks that contact dates are logical (not in the past, not before end date).

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles actions after lead update, like calendar events and prospects update.

methods.name: before_insert
methods.description: Creates contact document before inserting lead.

methods.name: after_insert
methods.description: Updates links after lead insertion.

methods.name: update_links
methods.description: Updates contact links for the lead.

methods.name: add_calendar_event
methods.description: Adds a calendar event for the lead's next contact date if setting is enabled.

methods.name: update_prospects
methods.description: Updates associated prospects for the lead.

methods.name: check_email_id_is_unique
methods.description: Ensures the email address is unique among leads if duplication is not allowed.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Handles cleanup when lead is deleted.

methods.name: unlink_dynamic_links
methods.description: Removes dynamic links associated with the lead.

methods.name: has_customer
methods.description: Checks if a customer exists for this lead.

methods.name: has_opportunity
methods.description: Checks if an opportunity exists for this lead.

methods.name: has_quotation
methods.description: Checks if a quotation exists for this lead.

methods.name: has_lost_quotation
methods.description: Checks if a lost quotation exists for this lead.

methods.name: set_lead_name
methods.description: Sets the lead name based on company or email.

methods.name: set_title
methods.description: Sets the lead's title.

methods.name: create_contact
methods.description: Creates a contact document based on lead details if auto-creation is enabled.
